tools.name: eth_price
tools.description: Current ETH price in US dollars, from Chainlink. Swaps are refused when Uniswap pays more than 3% below it.

tools.name: quote_eth_to_usdc
tools.description: Uniswap's exact quote for selling ETH for USDC right now, fees and price impact included.

tools.name: quote_usdc_to_eth
tools.description: Uniswap's exact quote for selling USDC for ETH right now, fees and price impact included.

tools.name: usdc_balance
tools.description: USDC balance of a wallet (Circle's test USDC on Sepolia).

tools.name: eth_to_usdc
tools.description: Sell ETH for USDC on Uniswap v4. Quote first and set min_usdc about 1% below the quote. Refused below that, or more than 3% below Chainlink's price.

min_usdc.description: Least USDC to accept, such as the quote minus 1%

recipient.description: Who gets the USDC: an address or ENS name. The user's own wallet unless they name someone.

call.function: function swapEthToUsdc(uint256 minUsdcOut, address recipient) payable returns (uint256)

tools.name: usdc_to_eth
tools.description: Sell USDC for ETH on Uniswap v4. Quote first and set min_eth about 1% below the quote. Refused below that, or more than 3% below Chainlink's price.

min_eth.description: Least ETH to accept, such as the quote minus 1%

recipient.description: Who gets the ETH: an address or ENS name. The user's own wallet unless they name someone.

call.function: function swapUsdcToEth(uint256 usdcIn, uint256 minEthOut, address recipient) returns (uint256)
